about: The full film’s transcript and scene descriptions, as one Task Object. The film of October 31 named a model the owner no longer shows, so its cut, its captions and its lines are gone; this Task Object waits for the re-recorded cut. When its lines are filled from that cut’s production plan, scripts/build_site.py renders /film/ again, and tests/test_build_site.py checks the narration against the cut’s captions word for word. With no lines, /film/ is not built.

description: The full film’s transcript and scene descriptions: every line of narration, word for word as the captions give it, with when it plays and what is on screen.

note: Narration is an AI voice. Every example in the film uses example data, and every number comes from one of our measured evaluations.
